article.story: SAINT GEORGE, Utah -- — Christian Gibson scored 17 points as Utah Tech beat Grace U 103-52 on Wednesday. Gibson also contributed eight rebounds for the Trailblazers (1-1). Aris Rodriguez scored 15 points, shooting 4 for 11 (0 for 6 from 3-point range) and 7 of 9 from the free-throw line. Ethan Potter shot 6 of 9 from the field and 3 of 3 from the free-throw line to finish with 15 points. Noah Charles led the way for the Talons with 15 points. Grace also got 11 points and two blocks from Nehemiah Johnson. Up next Utah Tech plays Tuesday against Utah State on the road. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
